query: SELECT c.id, c.code, c.name, c.type, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT cl.classCode ORDER BY cl.classCode SEPARATOR ', ') as turmas FROM components c LEFT JOIN classes cl ON cl.componentId = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.code, c.name, c.type ORDER BY c.code;
